column1: # Curated renames applied on top of the derived MCP->official maps.
# Mapping mcpName to itself removes a derived rename instead.
# getDefaultState is ambiguous in the mappings (Block vs Fluid); the mod calls
# it almost exclusively on blocks. getPos is ambiguous across receivers; the
# dominant use in the mod is TileEntity#getPos -> BlockEntity#getBlockPos.
# Names below collide with JDK / external-library / already-ported identifiers;
# a stray vanilla member sharing the MCP name would otherwise rename them
# Identity mapping removes the derived rename.
